purpose_context: Attendees following the talk on a phone have no browser Console, so they cannot see the results Quadrano writes for each data layer push. This mission adds an opt-in Results view to the Demo menu that repeats the runtime's Console output verbatim, off by default so the presenter's stage path is unchanged. The shop still never judges a push itself. It reopens the on-page panel ruled out of scope in issue 4 and carries the governance changes that reversal needs.
purpose_tldr: Let attendees on phones see what Quadrano says about each push, on the page, by repeating the runtime's own Console output in the Demo menu.
